$comment: Dead-slot ledger (RAIL-STYLING-REALIZATION-LEDGERS-01). Two-directional ratchet: the audit fails if any dead slot is missing here (unledgered) or if any entry no longer reproduces (stale). Entries may only be REMOVED by proving the slot consumed or by deleting the declaration — never by loosening the scan. In particular, do NOT widen consumption scanning to <C>.tokens.css: a slot redefinition is not a consumption, and admitting it would mass-false-green the entire re-point class. `disposition` and `note` are computed by scripts/dead-slot-audit/disposition.mjs; `review` means no rule matched and the entry needs human adjudication, NOT that it is safe to delete.
